name: dcid-grammar-colon-prefixed-set-ref-rejected
description: A set-state slot binding whose refs array carries a dcid:-prefixed spelling among otherwise-valid members is refused: the dcid grammar dcid-grammar-colon-prefixed-rejected already enforces on shape dcids and dcid-grammar-colon-prefixed-slot-ref-rejected on a value-state slot ref, now also runs on every set ref.
